# Third-party license texts

`licenses/Apache-2.0.txt` is a byte-for-byte copy of the Agent Plugins
Specification license text published at
https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec/blob/main/LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt.
It applies to the vendored deterministic schema snapshot documented in
[`../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), not to the OCI Founder
Toolkit's original content.

The upstream Agent Plugins repository listing reviewed on 2026-09-18 contained
no root `NOTICE` file to preserve. Any future schema refresh must repeat that
check and update the local license text, attribution, and hashes together.
